title: The Armor of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The armor of God is the spiritual equipment God gives believers so they can stand firm against the schemes of the devil. It includes truth, righteousness, the Gospel, faith, salvation, the Word of God, and prayer.
summary: The armor of God is the spiritual equipment God gives believers so they can stand firm against the schemes of the devil. It includes truth, righteousness, the Gospel, faith, salvation, the Word of God, and prayer.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the believer’s strength and protection. The armor God gives is not self-confidence, but the truth and salvation found in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Paul commands believers to be strong in the Lord and in the strength of His might. The armor of God is necessary because the battle is real and believers cannot stand by human strength alone.

Each piece of armor points to God’s provision. Truth guards against lies, righteousness guards against compromise, the Gospel gives firm footing, faith extinguishes attacks, salvation protects hope, and the Word of God is the Spirit’s sword.

Prayer surrounds the whole command. The armor is not a technique apart from communion with God. Believers stand by dependence, watchfulness, and perseverance.

The armor of God keeps spiritual warfare practical and Christ-centered. The believer stands not by secret formulas, but by truth, holiness, faith, Scripture, and prayer.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
This doctrine matters because believers often face spiritual attacks through lies, fear, temptation, accusation, discouragement, and confusion. God has not left His people unarmed.

It also protects from theatrical or superstitious views of warfare. God’s armor is not a performance; it is daily faithfulness in the strength He supplies.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Put on the armor God gives by living in truth, trusting Christ’s righteousness, standing in the Gospel, exercising faith, holding fast to salvation, using Scripture, and praying at all times. Do not fight spiritual battles with pride, panic, or human strength.
